method: PCA(3) on 48-d MTNN embeddings; axes min-max scaled for the explorer map.

axes.name: Craft axis 1
axes.lo: higher Arch: Shot Volume + Three-Point Volume, Skill: shooting
axes.hi: higher Arch: Offensive Glass (Low Shot Volume), Arch: Offensive Glass + Rim Protection

axes.name: Craft axis 2
axes.lo: higher Arch: Three-Point Accuracy + Three-Point Volume, Arch: Three-Point Volume (Low On-Court Impact)
axes.hi: higher Arch: Scoring Volume + Shot Volume, Arch: Defensive Glass + Rim Pressure (Fts)

axes.name: Craft axis 3
axes.lo: higher Arch: Defensive Glass + Rim Pressure (Fts), Skill: Defensive Rebounding
axes.hi: higher Arch: Playmaking + Steals, Skill: Playmaking
